description:
We are seeking a dedicated Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role offers the opportunity to significantly impact patient care and support our nursing team, ensuring the highest standards of clinical excellence and operational efficiency.

As an ADON, you will work closely with the Director of Nursing to oversee daily nursing operations, staff supervision, and quality assurance initiatives. This position offers a competitive salary range of $60,000 - $75,000 per year, reflecting your expertise and commitment to providing exceptional care.
requirements: Previous experience in a supervisory or leadership nursing role
Experience within a skilled nursing or long-term care environment
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, compensation based on experience.

description: Join a dedicated team at a premier rehabilitation center in Frostburg, MD, as a Unit Manager, Wound Care (RN). This vital full-time role offers a unique opportunity to lead a nursing unit while specializing in comprehensive wound care management, ensuring the highest standards of patient recovery and well-being.In this leadership position, you will be responsible for the daily operations of your unit, staff supervision, and the development and implementation of individualized wound care plans. We are seeking a compassionate and skilled Registered Nurse eager to make a significant impact on patient outcomes. The hourly rate for this role is competitive, ranging from $35.00 to $40.00, commensurate with your experience.If you are an experienced RN with a passion for wound care and leadership, we encourage you to apply and become a part of a facility committed to excellence in patient rehabilitation.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of experience in wound care management
Previous experience in a leadership or supervisory nursing role
Strong assessment and critical thinking skills
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $35.00 - $40.00 based on experience.
